clips.title: The story
paras: Across Mulgore, cougars prowl the plains, and Maur Raincaller needs one of their bones. A Flatland Cougar Femur is part of the remedy he seeks for a venomous bite.

Flatland cougars rank among Mulgore's most dangerous native stalkers. They blend into the dry brush, then spring upon unsuspecting prey. Hunters take their pelts and claws for leatherworking and trophies, while their heavy, marrow-rich bones have use in local medicine. Maur Raincaller of Bloodhoof Village suffered a venomous wound from Mazzranache, a monstrous pink strider. He urgently asked for a cougar femur and parts from other local beasts. Crushed or boiled, the bone yields properties for an antitoxin poultice meant to draw fever and necrotic venom from a festering bite.
